messages:
ada: Customer reported duplicated token billing after streaming truncation + route failover. Minimal logs attached.
vic: Likely the route swap cleared ephemeral session headers; retry looked like a fresh request.
kim: Logs: `2026-06-10T12:01:10Z stream EOF seq=900; toolcall id=tc-900; 2026-06-10T12:01:11Z route.swap -> clear-ephemeral; 2026-06-10T12:01:11Z reconnect replay -> toolcall id=tc-900-R`
ada: (note) we should prefer client-side idempotency tokens, but can't rely on all clients. Server fallback needed.
vic: Proposal: compute a dedupe_fingerprint = sha256(normalize(payload)+tool_name+customer_id). Only suppress second provisional billing when: same fingerprint, same customer, prior event state == PROVISIONAL, and reconnect_delta < 600ms OR route.swap flagged.
kim: Important: never delete raw events. Create a suppression_record linking original_event_id <-> duplicate_event_id and mark duplicate as suppressed for billing UI. Keep ability to replay.
ops-bot: Feature-flag created: server_retry_dedupe. Per-customer opt-out tag: no_server_dedupe.
console-team: UX: show badge "Provisional (suppressed)" with hover text "Suppressed by server heuristic due to suspected retry. Click to view raw events." Add filter for suppressed charges and an "Request audit" action.
vic: Telemetry: emit dedupe.fingerprint, dedupe.applied=true|false, dedupe.outcome=suppressed|annotated, dedupe.trace_link. Backfill fingerprints for 7d to estimate collision rate before enabling suppression.
ada: Tests: unit tests for fingerprint collisions, integration tests simulating route.swap + fast reconnects. Canary plan: annotate-only mode at 5% traffic for 48h, then gradual suppression if metrics OK.
kim: Edge case: suppression affects billing events only; if retry actually executed downstream, we'll still have two executions. Document and recommend client idempotency for tool implementations.
ops-bot: RW-14077 created: "server fallback dedupe for retry-induced provisional toolcall charges". Canary scheduled: 2026-06-18 08:00 UTC (annotate-only).
ada: I'll own the RFC and rollout plan. vic: server patch + tests. kim: telemetry + dashboards. console-team: UI mock.
ada: Add emergency kill switch and annotate-only toggle. Keep raw events immutable.
console-team: We'll share screenshots in RW-14077.
ada: Thanks all, follow-ups in the ticket.
